name: slop-detect-mcp
description: MCP server that scores any landing page against the AI-design-slop fingerprint (deterministic 0-100, real Chromium), copy tells, DESIGN.md compliance, and AEO readiness, and builds fix prompts.

transport.notes: Local stdio MCP server. Install via npm (slop-detect-mcp). Calls the public slop-detect.com API; no API key required.

tools.name: scan_page
tools.description: Score a URL against the design-slop fingerprint (optionally copy and DESIGN.md axes). Returns score, tier, grade, and triggered patterns.

tools.name: check_aeo
tools.description: Score whether AI engines (ChatGPT/Claude/Perplexity) can fetch, read and cite a page. Higher is better.

tools.name: check_design_system
tools.description: Check whether a page honors its own declared design system (a DESIGN.md file). Returns a 0-100 compliance score (higher is better) plus named drift.

tools.name: fix_prompt
tools.description: Build a ready-to-paste prompt instructing a coding agent how to de-slop a page from a scan result or URL.

prompts.name: audit_landing_page
prompts.description: Run a full 4-axis audit (Design, Copy, System DESIGN.md, and AEO) on a URL.

prompts.name: deslop_and_verify
prompts.description: Closed-loop workflow: scan a page, generate a remediation prompt, apply fixes, and re-verify.
